title: Autosize
description: Deprecated. Grows a textarea to fit its content as the user types; use <textarea autosize> instead.
deprecated: Use <textarea autosize> -- textarea.js already grows every textarea with that attribute, and also honors maxRows, which x-autosize does not. x-autosize still works and logs a one-time console warning.
